title: Collected-money metric sparkline renders net-sales series

evidence.reasoning: Local series projects only NetSalesPiastres then is passed to both total-sales card and actual-collected card; collected value and comparison use distinct DTO fields.
Shared metric template renders each label/value and SparklineView Points bound to that card Points property.
TrendPointDto has NetSalesPiastres and OrderCount, no collected-series measure.

trigger: A range whose sales timing differs from collections, for example deferred delivery cash or pending electronic sales. Actual-collected card receives sales sparkline regardless its distinct amount.
rootCause: RebuildMetrics reuses one net-sales point list for two different measures without measure metadata.
impact: Owner can read a visually incorrect collection trend under actual money label. Financial ledger and numeric card value remain server-derived and unchanged.
counterarguments: Possible intended generic sales context decoration, but no text explains that actual-collected sparkline is sales and shared metric-card convention implies same measure.
When all sales are collected with matching timing, shapes may coincide, so not visible for every dataset.
No screenshot/native rendering observed; source binding proves supplied points only.
recommended_verification: Independent reviewer trace VM, XAML and Sparkline Points use; pure DTO fixture with unequal sales/collection timing. Do not write real financial records.
tests_missing: Metric-card label/measure/series consistency test with deferred collection.
